sources.title: callumrob/retrieval-finetuning · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Repository status The Python file contains the model and runnable example or training entry point. config.json records the generated architecture settings. training_args.json records the default experiment recipe. model.safetensors is a valid initialization checkpoint for smoke tests; it is not presented as a trained benchmark checkpoint. No benchmark score is claimed in this repository.

sources.title: Finetuning Retrieval for Fin - /research
sources.snippet: In this blog, we describe how we replaced a general-purpose retrieval model with the one fine-tuned on our high-quality customer support specific data, and the results of doing so. How does a retrieval model work? Fin's retrieval system is powered entirely by semantic search 1.
